faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions about our home care services.
faq.a1: We currently serve Ottawa and surrounding communities including Kanata, Nepean, Barrhaven, Orleans, and Gloucester. We are expanding thoughtfully across Canada.
faq.q2: How do you match caregivers with clients?
faq.a2: We carefully assess each client's needs, preferences, language, and personality, then match them with caregivers who have the right skills, experience, and temperament.
faq.q3: What types of care do you provide?
faq.a3: We offer personal care, senior home care, companion care, registered nursing, dementia support, and respite care — all tailored to individual needs.
faq.a4: After an initial consultation and assessment, care can often begin within a few days. Urgent situations are prioritized whenever possible.
faq.q5: How much does home care cost?
faq.a5: Costs vary based on the type and frequency of care needed. We provide transparent pricing during your free consultation with no obligation.
